task.description: Default NPPES organization-registry lookup for hospitals lacking an existing MRF-derived NPI, with no limit. Requires hospital list from documented earlier step; existing crosswalk is optional and if absent all hospitals are targets.
task.source_release: NPPES NPI Registry API version 2.1, current response at observation; upstream hospital list is a versioned source URL in build_hospital_list.py. Observation window and exact release provenance must be frozen prior to execution.
task.source_family: CMS NPPES NPI Registry organization records (shared upstream family with PILOT-02); prerequisite CMS Hospital General Information

Lookup reads a required generated hospital list and optionally an existing MRF-derived crosswalk; preserve the clean-cache baseline and absence/presence of this optional input in the case record.

The default queries potentially hundreds of facilities and API responses can change; rate limits, runtime, public terms and matched independent near-time reference feasibility require preflight. No result is known.
The NPI Registry can include individual providers; selected implementation requests NPI-2 organizational records only. Confirm allowed fields and non-patient boundaries before authorized execution.
